title: A log of medication given
description: The prescribed schedule and the family’s actual marks in one history for the pet.

blocks.text: After a reminder it is still not known whether the action was carried out. And if two people look after the animal, it has to be sorted out over messages.

quote.text: Helps me keep my 7 cats meds organized.The reminders help me stay on top and not miss a dose. Very easy to navigate.

blocks.text: On the pet’s card, keep the prescription and the events separately: who marked the dose, at what time, whether the record was corrected. The next reminder does not stand in for a mark that the action actually happened.
The app keeps a log of prescriptions rather than working out the treatment. A correction to the history has to be visible to the family.
